info.name: 26' BreachPoint - Full API
info.description:
Full API surface for the BreachPoint CTF backend (Elysia + Bun + Drizzle/Postgres).

## Setup
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default `http://localhost:8080`, matching `.env`).
2. Run **Auth > Sign Up** (or **Sign In**) — a test script stores the JWT into `{{token}}` automatically.
3. For anything under **Admin**, log in as a user whose `core_user.is_admin` is true; that request's script stores the JWT into `{{adminToken}}`. Admin is not grantable via the API — flip the column in the DB.

## Auth model
Every route except `GET /`, `POST /auth/signup` and `POST /auth/login` requires `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`. Tokens are HS256, expire after 1 day, and carry `sub` (user id) + `isAdmin`. `/admin/*` routes additionally require `isAdmin`.

## Error shape
All errors return `{ "error": "<message>" }` with status 400 (validation), 401 (missing/invalid token), 403 (not admin / banned), 404 (not found), 409 (conflict), 422 (request body failed schema validation) or 500.

## Round 1 — Signal Zero
The **Signal Zero (Round 1)** and **Admin - Time Glitch** folders cover the event module: three paths, a reveal window that always exposes 3 challenges, 4 skips per team, path switching, and hourly Time Glitch windows that suspend point decay. These routes need an event seeded with `bun run db:seed`; an event with no paths is a plain CTF and the module stays inert.

**Happy path:** Sign Up → Create Team → Submit Flag (welcome challenge) → List Paths → Select Path → Get Board → Submit Flag → Get Board.

## Scoring gates
Any request that changes points — flag submission, hint unlock, skip, path selection — additionally requires that the event is **published and inside its `startsAt`/`endsAt` window**, that the account is not banned, and that the team is not disqualified. All four failures return **403**.

request.description:
Liveness probe. No auth.

**200** → `{ "status": "ok" }`

Create an account and receive a JWT. No auth.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | string | required, 3-30 chars, case-insensitively unique |
| `email` | string | required, email format, case-insensitively unique |
| `password` | string | required, min 8 chars |

**200** → `{ "token": "<jwt>", "user": { "id": "<uuid>", "username": "sai", "isAdmin": false } }`

**409** → email already in use / username already taken.
**422** → body failed schema validation.

New accounts are always non-admin; promote by setting `core_user.is_admin = true` directly in Postgres.

Exchange credentials for a JWT. No auth.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string | required, email format |
| `password` | string | required, min 1 char |

Note: login is by **email only** — `username` is ignored if sent.

**200** → `{ "token": "<jwt>", "user": { "id", "username", "isAdmin" } }`

**401** → `Invalid email or password` (same message for unknown email and wrong password).
**403** → `This account has been banned`.

Current user derived from the bearer token. Auth required.

**200** → `{ "id": "<uuid>", "username": "sai", "isAdmin": false }`

**401** → missing / invalid / expired token.
**404** → token is valid but the user row is gone.

List events visible to the caller. Auth required.

Admins get **every** event (including drafts); regular users get only `isPublished = true` ones.

**200** → array of
```json
[
  {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "slug": "breachpoint-2026-r1",
    "name": "BreachPoint 2026 Round 1",
    "description": "...",
    "startsAt": "2026-03-01T09:00:00.000Z",
    "endsAt": "2026-03-01T21:00:00.000Z",
    "isPublished": true,
    "isFrozen": false,
    "frozenAt": null,
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "...",
    "createdBy": "<uuid>",
    "updatedBy": null
  }
]
```

Create a team for an event and become its captain. Auth required. Also auto-registers the caller for the event.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required, 1-50 chars, unique per event |

**200** → the team row plus `role`:
```json
{
  "id": "<uuid>",
  "eventId": "<uuid>",
  "name": "Segfault",
  "isSolo": false,
  "joinCode": "A1B2C3",
  "createdByUser": "<uuid>",
  "isHidden": false,
  "disqualifiedAt": null,
  "disqualifiedBy": null,
  "disqualifiedReason": null,
  "registeredAt": "...",
  "role": "captain"
}
```
The `joinCode` is saved to `{{joinCode}}` by a test script — hand it to teammates for **Join Team**.

**400** → event is not open for registration (not published).
**404** → event not found.
**409** → already in a team for this event / team name taken.

On a Signal Zero event this also opens the team's starting challenges — the welcome challenge, which gates path selection. See **Signal Zero (Round 1)**.

Join an existing team as a member. Auth required. Also auto-registers the caller for the event.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required — must match the team's name exactly |
| `joinCode` | string | required — the 6-char code from Create Team |

Both must match the same team; name and code are checked together.

**200** → the team row plus `"role": "member"`.

**400** → event not open, or team is full (max 4 members).
**404** → event not found, or `Team not found or join code is incorrect`.
**409** → you are already in a team for this event.

On a Signal Zero event this also opens the team's starting challenges — the welcome challenge, which gates path selection. See **Signal Zero (Round 1)**.

All challenge categories (global, not per-event). Auth required.

**200** →
```json
[
  { "id": 1, "name": "web", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...", "createdBy": "<uuid>", "updatedBy": null }
]
```
`id` is a small integer (smallserial), not a UUID.

Challenges for an event in state `visible` only. Auth required.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**200** → array of full challenge rows. Note that `flagHash` is currently included in the payload — the player list returns `select()` over the whole table.
```json
[
  {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "eventId": "<uuid>",
    "title": "Baby RSA",
    "description": "...",
    "categoryId": 1,
    "difficulty": "easy",
    "initialPoints": 500,
    "minPoints": 100,
    "decayThreshold": 25,
    "decayType": "logarithmic",
    "flagHash": "<sha256>",
    "state": "visible",
    "maxAttempts": 10,
    "author": "sai",
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "...",
    "createdBy": "<uuid>",
    "updatedBy": null
  }
]
```

**404** → event not found.

Hints for a challenge, with locked bodies redacted. Auth required **and** the caller must be in a team for this event.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId` — UUIDs.

**200** → hints ordered by `sortOrder`; `body` is `null` unless the caller's team has unlocked it:
```json
[
  {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "eventId": "<uuid>",
    "challengeId": "<uuid>",
    "cost": 50,
    "sortOrder": 0,
    "requiresHintId": null,
    "isUnlocked": false,
    "body": null,
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "...",
    "createdBy": "<uuid>",
    "updatedBy": null
  }
]
```

**400** → `You must be in a team to access hints`.
**404** → challenge not found.

Buy a hint for the caller's team. Auth required, team membership required. No request body.

The hint's `cost` is recorded as `costPaid` and is subtracted from the team's score on the scoreboard. Unlocks are per-team, not per-user.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId`, `hintId` — UUIDs.

**200** → the full hint (body revealed) plus:
```json
{
  "...hint fields": "...",
  "body": "Look at the exponent.",
  "isUnlocked": true,
  "costPaid": 50
}
```

**400** → not in a team, or `You must unlock the previous hint first` (when `requiresHintId` is set).
**404** → challenge or hint not found.
**409** → `Hint already unlocked`.

**Gating:** unlocking spends points, so it is gated exactly like a flag submission — **403** if the event has not started, has ended, or is not published, if the account is banned, or if the team is disqualified. (Reading the hint list via **List Hints (player)** only needs team membership.)

Submit a flag on behalf of the caller's team. Auth required, team membership required.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId` — UUIDs.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `flag` | string | required, min 1 char |

The flag is trimmed and SHA-256 hashed before comparison, so leading/trailing whitespace is forgiving but the rest is case-sensitive and exact.

**Every verdict is HTTP 200** — read `verdict`:

| verdict | body |
| --- | --- |
| `incorrect` | `{ "verdict": "incorrect", "message": "Incorrect flag" }` |
| `duplicate` | `{ "verdict": "duplicate", "message": "Your team has already solved this challenge" }` |
| `rate_limited` | `{ "verdict": "rate_limited", "message": "Maximum attempts (10) reached" }` |

A **correct** submission returns the full scoring breakdown:
```json
{
  "verdict": "correct",
  "message": "First blood! Correct flag!",
  "basePoints": 250,
  "multiplier": "0.80",
  "pointsAwarded": 200,
  "solveOrder": 1,
  "firstBlood": true,
  "timeGlitch": { "id": "<uuid>", "label": "Glitch 1" },
  "postStory": "You've placed it: a second Meridian site...",
  "fragment": "who",
  "revealed": ["<uuid>"]
}
```

| field | meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `basePoints` | the challenge's value at that instant — decayed by prior solves, **or full `initialPoints` if a Time Glitch was active** |
| `multiplier` | the active path attempt's reward multiplier (`1.00`, or `0.80` after a skip or an early switch) |
| `pointsAwarded` | `ROUND(basePoints × multiplier)` — the only number the leaderboard reads, snapshotted permanently |
| `timeGlitch` | the window that boosted this solve, else `null` |
| `postStory` | the narration to display after a correct submission; `null` for pathless challenges |
| `fragment` | `who` / `how` / `why` when this was a path's final challenge, else `null` |
| `revealed` | challenge ids the solve just unlocked — fetch **Get Board** to render them |

All of it (submission, solve, fragment, reveal writes) lands in one transaction.

Every attempt is recorded in `core_submission` regardless of verdict.

**400** → not in a team, or — on a Signal Zero event — `That challenge is not open to your team yet` (it has not been revealed to this team).
**403** → event has not started / has ended / is not published, account is banned, or the team is disqualified.
**404** → challenge not found, or not in state `visible`.

item.name: Signal Zero (Round 1)

request.description:
The event page in a single call. Auth required, team membership required.

Runs the reveal engine before reading, so the response is always the team's correct current window — no separate refresh call.

**200**
```json
{
  "path": {
    "id": "<uuid>", "code": "A", "name": "THE ARCHIVIST",
    "delivers": "who", "introNarration": "...",
    "rewardMultiplier": "1.00", "entryReason": "initial",
    "solved": 3, "total": 10
  },
  "challenges": [
    {
      "id": "<uuid>", "title": "Ash and Bare Rock",
      "description": "...", "categoryId": 1, "difficulty": "easy",
      "initialPoints": 100, "minPoints": 50, "maxAttempts": null, "author": null,
      "sequence": 1, "tier": "past", "isPathFinal": false,
      "status": "solved", "preStory": "...", "postStory": "..."
    }
  ],
  "standalone": [ { "id": "<uuid>", "title": "Transmission Zero", "status": "solved" } ],
  "skips": { "used": 1, "remaining": 3, "quota": 4 },
  "fragments": ["who"],
  "timeGlitch": { "active": null, "next": { "startsAt": "...", "endsAt": "..." } }
}
```

**`challenges`** holds only the team's active path, and only what has been revealed — normally 3 with `status: "open"`, plus everything already `solved` or `skipped`. `postStory` is `null` until the challenge is solved; `preStory` is always present. `flagHash` is never returned.

**`standalone`** holds pathless challenges: the welcome challenge, and the convergence final once all three fragments are held.

**`path`** is `null` before a path is selected.

**400** → not in a team.
**403** → event not started / ended / not published, account banned, team disqualified.

The three paths with their intro narration, and whether each is still available to this team. Auth required, team membership required.

**200**
```json
{
  "welcomeSolved": true,
  "canSelect": true,
  "paths": [
    {
      "id": "<uuid>", "code": "A", "name": "THE ARCHIVIST",
      "delivers": "who", "introNarration": "...",
      "isActive": false, "isAvailable": true, "rewardMultiplier": null
    }
  ]
}
```

`isAvailable` is false for any path the team has already entered — a finished or abandoned path can never be re-entered.

`canSelect` is true only when the welcome challenge is solved and no path is currently active. The first path id is saved to `{{pathId}}`.

**404** → this event has no paths (not a Signal Zero event).

Choose the team's first path. Auth required, team membership required.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pathId` | string | required, a path UUID from **List Paths** |

Reveals the path's first **2** challenges. The choice is team-wide.

**200** → `{ "path": { ... }, "attempt": { "id": "<uuid>", "rewardMultiplier": "1.00", "entryReason": "initial", ... } }`

**400** → welcome challenge not solved yet, or not in a team.
**404** → path not found.
**409** → already on a path (use **Switch Path**), or this path was already run.

Move the team to a different path. Auth required, team membership required.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pathId` | string | required, a path the team has never entered |

**The cost depends on progress in the current path:**

| solves in active path | `entryReason` | multiplier on the new path |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8 or more | `free_switch` | `1.00` |
| fewer than 8 | `penalized_switch` | `0.80` |

The penalty applies to **future earnings on the new path only**. Points already banked keep the value they were awarded at — switching never rewrites solve history.

**200** → `{ "path": {...}, "attempt": {...}, "free": true, "solvesInPreviousPath": 8, "message": "Free switch — full rewards on the new path" }`

**400** → not on a path yet, or already on the requested path.
**404** → path not found.
**409** → the team has already run that path, or a switch is already in progress.

Spend one of the team's skips to close a challenge without solving it. Auth required, team membership required.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `challengeId` | string | required, must be currently open on the active path |

**Quota is 4 per team for the whole event** — it does *not* reset when switching paths.

Effects: the reveal window advances as if solved, and the active path's multiplier drops to `0.80`. **No solve row is written**, so a skipped challenge is worth **zero**, not 80% of its value.

**200**
```json
{
  "skipped": "<uuid>",
  "skipsUsed": 1,
  "skipsRemaining": 3,
  "rewardMultiplier": "0.80",
  "revealed": ["<uuid>"],
  "message": "Challenge skipped. Rewards on this path are now 80%. 3 skip(s) left."
}
```

**400** → no skips left, not on a path, challenge not on the active path, challenge not revealed yet, or the challenge is pathless (welcome/convergence cannot be skipped).
**404** → challenge not found or not visible.
**409** → already solved, or already skipped.

Whether point decay is suspended right now, and when the next window opens. Auth required.

**200** → `{ "active": { "id": "<uuid>", "label": "Glitch 1", "endsAt": "..." }, "next": { ... } }`

`active` is `null` outside a window. Any challenge solved while a glitch is active scores its **full `initialPoints`** instead of the decayed value, and that is banked permanently.

Intended for a countdown/banner on the event page.

item.description:
Round 1's module: paths, the reveal window, skips, path switching and the Time Glitch.

These routes only apply to an event that has paths seeded (`bun run db:seed`). An event with no paths is a plain CTF and the module never engages.

**Intended order:** solve the welcome challenge (**Challenges > Submit Flag**) → **List Paths** → **Select Path** → **Get Board** → submit flags → **Get Board** again to see the window advance.

request.description:
Event scoreboard. Auth required.

If the event has been frozen (`isFrozen` + `frozenAt` set via **Admin > Events > Update Event**), the board is recomputed as of `frozenAt` instead of live.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**200** →
```json
{
  "frozen": false,
  "frozenAt": null,
  "entries": [
    {
      "teamId": "<uuid>",
      "displayName": "Segfault",
      "isSolo": false,
      "score": 1250,
      "solveCount": 4,
      "lastSolveAt": "...",
      "rank": 1
    }
  ]
}
```
`score` is solve points **minus** hint costs paid. Ties break on earlier `lastSolveAt`.

**404** → event not found.

**Freezing:** when the event has `isFrozen` set with a `frozenAt` cutoff, the response is `{ "frozen": true, "frozenAt": "...", "entries": [...] }` and the standings are computed as of that timestamp — solves and hint purchases after the cutoff are excluded. Otherwise `frozen` is `false` and the board is live. Revoked solves, hidden teams and disqualified teams are excluded either way.

item.name: Admin - Events
item.description: Admin only: requires a JWT whose `isAdmin` claim is true. These requests send `{{adminToken}}`. A non-admin token returns **403**; a missing one returns **401**.

request.description:
Create a draft event. Admin only.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required, min 1 char |
| `slug` | string | optional — defaults to a slugified `name` (lowercased, non-alphanumerics stripped, spaces to `-`); must be globally unique |
| `description` | string | optional |
| `startsAt` | string | optional ISO-8601 datetime |
| `endsAt` | string | optional ISO-8601 datetime, must be after `startsAt` |

Events are created **unpublished and unfrozen**. Publish with **Update Event** — which requires both timestamps to be set.

**200** → the created event row; its `id` is saved to `{{eventId}}`.

**409** → `Slug "..." is already in use`.
**422** → body failed schema validation.

Patch an event. Admin only. All fields optional — send only what changes.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**Body**
| field | type | notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | min 1 char |
| `description` | string | |
| `startsAt` | string | ISO-8601 datetime |
| `endsAt` | string | ISO-8601 datetime, must be after `startsAt` |
| `isPublished` | boolean | gates play and team registration |
| `isFrozen` | boolean | `true` stamps `frozenAt = now()` and freezes the scoreboard; `false` clears it |

`slug` is **not** patchable.

**200** → the updated event row.

**400** → `Cannot publish event without startsAt and endsAt`.
**404** → event not found.

item.name: Admin - Categories
item.description: Admin only: requires a JWT whose `isAdmin` claim is true. These requests send `{{adminToken}}`. A non-admin token returns **403**; a missing one returns **401**.

request.description:
Create a global challenge category. Admin only.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | required, 1-50 chars, unique |

**200** → `{ "id": 1, "name": "web", "createdAt": "...", "updatedAt": "...", "createdBy": "<uuid>", "updatedBy": null }` — `id` is saved to `{{categoryId}}`.

**409** → `Category "web" already exists`.

Delete a category. Admin only.

**Path**: `id` — the numeric category id (smallserial), not a UUID.

**200** → the deleted category row.

**404** → `Category not found`.
**500** → challenges still reference this category (foreign-key violation) — reassign them first.

item.name: Admin - Challenges
item.description: Admin only: requires a JWT whose `isAdmin` claim is true. These requests send `{{adminToken}}`. A non-admin token returns **403**; a missing one returns **401**.

request.description:
Every challenge for an event, in **all** states (`hidden`, `visible`, `locked`). Admin only.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**200** → array of full challenge rows, including `flagHash`.

**404** → event not found.

Create a challenge. Admin only.

**Path**: `eventId` — event UUID.

**Body**
| field | type | required | rules / default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes | min 1 char |
| `description` | string | yes | min 1 char |
| `categoryId` | number | yes | must exist in `/categories` |
| `difficulty` | enum | yes | `easy` \| `medium` \| `hard` \| `expert` |
| `initialPoints` | number | yes | ≥ 1 |
| `minPoints` | number | yes | ≥ 1, must be ≤ `initialPoints` |
| `decayThreshold` | number | no | ≥ 1, default **25** — solves until `minPoints` |
| `decayType` | enum | no | `logarithmic` (default) \| `linear` \| `static` |
| `flag` | string | yes | plaintext; stored as a SHA-256 hash, never returned |
| `maxAttempts` | number | no | ≥ 1; omit for unlimited |
| `author` | string | no | credit line |

New challenges are created in state **`hidden`** — players will not see them until you PATCH `state` to `visible`.

**200** → the created challenge row (with `flagHash`, not `flag`); `id` is saved to `{{challengeId}}`.

**400** → `minPoints cannot exceed initialPoints`.
**404** → event not found / category not found.
**422** → body failed schema validation.

Patch a challenge. Admin only. All fields optional — send only what changes. This is how you publish one: `{ "state": "visible" }`.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId` — UUIDs.

**Body** — same fields as Create, all optional, plus:
| field | type | notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `state` | enum | `hidden` \| `visible` \| `locked` — pull a broken challenge with `hidden`, never a delete (a delete takes its solves and submissions with it) |
| `maxAttempts` | number \| null | explicit `null` restores unlimited attempts |
| `flag` | string | re-hashed on write; omit to keep the current flag |

`minPoints ≤ initialPoints` is validated against the merged result, so patching one of the pair alone is checked against the stored other.

**200** → the updated challenge row.

**400** → `minPoints cannot exceed initialPoints`.
**404** → challenge not found (also when it belongs to a different event) / category not found.

item.name: Admin - Hints
item.description: Admin only: requires a JWT whose `isAdmin` claim is true. These requests send `{{adminToken}}`. A non-admin token returns **403**; a missing one returns **401**.

request.description:
All hints for a challenge with bodies in the clear, ordered by `sortOrder`. Admin only.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId` — UUIDs.

**200** →
```json
[
  {
    "id": "<uuid>",
    "eventId": "<uuid>",
    "challengeId": "<uuid>",
    "body": "Look at the exponent.",
    "cost": 50,
    "sortOrder": 0,
    "requiresHintId": null,
    "createdAt": "...",
    "updatedAt": "...",
    "createdBy": "<uuid>",
    "updatedBy": null
  }
]
```

**404** → challenge not found.

Add a hint to a challenge. Admin only.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId` — UUIDs.

**Body**
| field | type | required | rules / default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | string | yes | min 1 char — the hint text |
| `cost` | number | no | ≥ 0, default **0**; deducted from a team's score on unlock |
| `sortOrder` | number | no | ≥ 0, default **0**; must be unique within the challenge |
| `requiresHintId` | string | no | UUID of a hint that must be unlocked first (tiered hints); cannot be the hint itself |

Note the field is literally named `body` inside the JSON body.

**200** → the created hint row; `id` is saved to `{{hintId}}`.

**404** → challenge not found.
**500** → duplicate `(challengeId, sortOrder)` — give each hint on a challenge a distinct `sortOrder`.

Delete a hint. Admin only.

**Path**: `eventId`, `challengeId`, `hintId` — UUIDs. Only `eventId` and `hintId` are actually used for the lookup; `challengeId` is there for URL shape.

Any hint that pointed at this one via `requiresHintId` has that link set to NULL.

**200** → the deleted hint row.

**404** → `Hint not found`.

item.name: Admin - Time Glitch

request.description:
Every glitch window for the event, earliest first. Admin only.

**200** → array of `{ id, eventId, label, startsAt, endsAt, announced, ... }`.

**404** → event not found.

Define one glitch window by hand. Admin only.

**Body**
| field | type | rules |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | string | optional, e.g. `Glitch 03:17` |
| `startsAt` | string | required, ISO-8601 timestamp |
| `endsAt` | string | required, ISO-8601, must be after `startsAt` |

Windows are stored as explicit rows rather than derived from an "every hour" rule, so the scoring of any past solve stays auditable even if a window is later moved or cancelled.

**200** → the created row.

**400** → invalid timestamps, `endsAt` not after `startsAt`, or the window overlaps an existing glitch.
**404** → event not found.

Generate the whole event's glitch schedule in one call, instead of entering each window by hand. Admin only.

**Body**
| field | type | default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `everyMinutes` | number | `60` — spacing between window starts |
| `durationMinutes` | number | `10` — length of each window |
| `firstAt` | string | optional ISO-8601; defaults to one interval after the event start |

Fills from `firstAt` up to the event's `endsAt`, labelling them `Glitch 1`, `Glitch 2`, …

**200** → array of created rows.

**400** → event has no `startsAt`/`endsAt`, `durationMinutes` is not less than `everyMinutes`, or the event already has glitches (delete them first).
**404** → event not found.

Remove a glitch window. Admin only.
